sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sanguine Twin (血刃双刀) is a dual-wielded blade pair in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Dual-wield branch of the Sanguine family, taken from the First Meeting with Yu'er beat in Weeping Creek Valley.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Sanguine Twin (血刃双刀) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as Dual-wield. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Sanguine Twin (血刃双刀) has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Nothing verified has been published on how Sanguine Twin (血刃双刀) behaves inside a combo, so no chain is described here. The general rule still applies: swapping to a secondary refills stamina instead of spending it, so the second slot is what extends a chain past the point the blade you were using runs dry - see the combat system.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Weeping Creek Valley, First Meeting with Yu'er bell.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.
